fnol_text: My name is Noor Laurent and I live at 558 Foxglove Place, Ashland, OR 97552. You can reach me on (555) 553-2071 or noor.laurent@example.com. On 26 July 2026 flash flooding came down the street while my car was parked at home. Water got into the cabin and the engine won't start. Policy MT-2025-00013. I'd like to claim for the damage to my car.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Ms Laurent on (555) 553-2071 to acknowledge the claim. Noor confirmed the loss date as 26 July 2026.
Vehicle inspected at the repairer. Witness Owen Khan gave a statement by phone.
Noor sent photos and a contractor's estimate. Water line visible on walls.
